newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Moody's confirms Aaa rating of Swiss Re.
newsitem.headline: Moody's confirms Aaa rating of Swiss Re.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service said it confirmed its Aaa insurance financial strength rating of Swiss Reinsurance Co. and its subsidiaries, concluding a review that was begun on August 27.

Moody's said in a statement from its London office received in Zurich that it also confirmed the Aaa ratings on the senior unsecured debt of SwissRe Finance (Bermuda) Ltd. and SwissRe Finance (US) Inc.

Around $650 million of long-term debt was affected by the review, which followed Swiss Re's decision to acquire the Mercantile & General Reinsurance Co. Plc from Prudential Corp. for 1.7 billion sterling.

The ratings' confirmation is based on Swiss Re's "superior global reinsurance franchise, reflected by strong positions in the globally diverse markets in which it operates, by its disciplined underwriting, by its conservative capitalisation and by its consistent profitability," Moody's said.

Although the cash-funded acquisition of Mercantile & General would increase Swiss Re's leverage in the short term, the benefits to be derived from the combination, including the diversification of Swiss Re's earnings' sources, would be a long-term improvement to Swiss Re's financial and competitive position, it added.

Swiss Re's growing emphasis on shareholder returns will put pressure on its finances, but Moody's said it expects management to balance the interest of shareholders and policy holders through its disciplined approach to business.
